body: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet original fictional Nettle Turbo 2017: compact front-engine two-seat roadster with long sculpted hood, short rear deck and CLOSED dark fabric convertible roof, faded wine-red body and charcoal repaired lower panels. Post-apocalyptic 2994 salvage world. Reference ONLY sheet order and painterly style, NOT wedge shape. Distinct original design with slim trapezoid headlights, split simple grille, two horizontal rounded rear lamp bars, subtle worn paint and patch repairs. No logos, text, badges or exact real-car reproduction. Exactly 8 views in TWO rows FOUR equal cells: top front, front-right45(nose left), right side(nose left), rear-left45(nose right); bottom rear, rear-right45(nose left), left side(nose right), front-left45(nose right). Consistent proportions and details, fully inside each cell with clear gaps. Wide 3:1 orthographic-ish realistic hand-painted racing-game texture. Genuine transparent background. CRITICAL runtime wheels separately: NO wheels, tires, brakes, axles; every wheel arch is alpha-transparent open semicircular cutout connected to space below body. Never black-filled wheel wells, no opposite tires behind holes, no shadows or scenery. Medium 17-inch wheel openings. Closed roof all views. Do not copy fluorescent edge fringes from reference.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Production dashboard overlay for fictional Nettle Turbo 2017 compact two-seat sports roadster, weathered wine-red and charcoal post-apocalyptic2994 salvage world. Reference1 layout/style only, reference2 bodyidentity. LEFT HAND DRIVE. Curved modern dark padded dashboard with stitched faded burgundy lower fascia, modest round vents, center rectangular plain infotainment inset, three physical climate controls. Distinct design from angular reference. Empty wide dark instrument recess lower LEFT from approximately x260–800 y555–715 on2000x800canvas. Runtime gauges added later: no baked numbers, needles, text, logos, brands, emblems. NO steering wheel or hands, steering column, seats, gear lever. Eye-level driver view wide2.5:1. Dashboard spans lower edge, transparent windshield upper half, transparent outside pillars. No scenery, no glass tint. Genuine alpha. Hand-painted realistic detailed, worn but structurally sound, consistent with body.
